name: A10-0290/2026 – Emma Ytterell – Article 5, § 1 – Am 114
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 1. Changes or extensions of projects to ensure decarbonisation or the reduction of emissions, including nitrogen emissions, shall only be subject to screeningincluding screening in the context of Article 6(3) of Council Directive 92/43/EEC, by the competent authorities in order to determine if they are likely to have significant effects on the environmentas defined in Directive 2011/92/EU. Where such changes or extensions are likely to have significant effects on the environment, taking into account the overall environmental effects of the modified or extended project, they shall be subject to an environmental assessment and an appropriate assessment under Article 6(3) of Council Directive 92/43/EEC. In assessing such changes or extensions, competent authorities shall take into account the environmental benefits resulting from emission reductions achieved by the modified or extended project, including where such reductions do not entirely eliminate the emissions associated with the original project. The reduction of emissions of one pollutant shall not, in itself, exempt the project from assessment of other potentially significant environmental effects.
